request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 60 seconds. Intense cold science-fiction battle score, forceful but intelligible without excessive treble. Driving polyrhythmic industrial drums, low brass-like synth stabs and fast string figures. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds.
